responsibilities: We are looking for a motivated fresher to join our AI engineering team as a Junior Generative AI / RAG Engineer.
Assist in building and testing Generative AI and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) applications.
Work with Python for AI/ML application development.
Build document processing, chunking, embedding, and retrieval pipelines.
Work with vector databases for semantic search and retrieval.
Integrate LLMs into AI applications and chatbot workflows.
Perform testing and evaluation of AI application outputs.
Collaborate with the team to debug and improve AI pipelines.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field.
